messages:
maya: FYI CI smoke failed on hosted API integrations for shard 9 — high failure rate across auth, streaming and tool-calling tests. ~40% red. Kicking for visibility @liam @samira
ci-bot: Build 8142 / shard 9 reported 401s and schema errors. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/8142/artifacts
liam: thanks. can you paste the failing test names + last few log lines? also which commit?
maya: commit b3d94f2, tests: tests/integration/test_auth.py::test_jwt_rotation, tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_stream_close_early, tests/integration/test_toolcall.py::test_tool_schema. snippet:
```
ERROR: 401 Unauthorized for POST /hosted/v1/generate
resp: {"error":"invalid_auth","msg":"kid not found"}
```
and
```
AssertionError: schema mismatch: expected object 'tool_call' got null
```
samira: hmm that kid error smells like key cache/rotation. we merged token-rotate PR yesterday — could be a propagation delay in kid publishing. can we rerun the shard? if it passes once it's probably a timing flake.
jordan: also saw a similar 401 in nightly yesterday but only for toolcall tests. suspect auth proxy starts rejecting keys when backend refresh happens. bisect range? last good ~b2f000.. to current b3d94f2.
maya: starting a rerun now: `ci rerun --build 8142 --shard 9`
ci-bot: Rerun queued (build 8142.1). will post results in ~10m.
liam: re: schema mismatch — did we change the tool payload shape in the SDK? anyone touch the tool v2 PR?
samira: no SDK schema changes in last two commits. runtime may be returning empty tool call when tool handshake fails. that would explain null.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: partial pass. auth tests still 401 (3/6), streaming tests 2/4 passed, tool_schema still failing (1/1). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/8142.1/artifacts
maya: thanks. samira can you bisect b2f000..b3d94f2 to see where kid publishing changed? if it's auth proxy bug we'll need an immediate fallback.
samira: I'll start a bisect on CI: `ci bisect --range b2f000..b3d94f2 --tests tests/integration/test_auth.py::test_jwt_rotation --parallel 4`
jordan: I'll look at proxy logs and token rotation job on staging. attaching quick grep output: `grep 'publishing kid' /var/logs/token-rotate.log | tail -n 20` shows intermittent failures.
liam: for short term mitigation, can we relax the hosted API's kid cache TTL so rotations don't fail producers? ops change, but low risk.
maya: opening a ticket and tagging eng-oncall in case this needs escalation: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4291
jordan: noted. if bisect points to the token-rotate deploy, we should rollback that change and push a hotfix to runtime to treat missing kid as retry, not immediate 401.
samira: bisect started, will report progress. assigning to myself for now.
ci-bot: bisect job queued (job 4592). updates will appear in thread.
maya: thanks everyone. ping @liam if you can prioritize an infra change to TTL if bisect shows correlation.
liam: on it, i'll draft a short config change and post CI flag to enable quick rollback.
maya: adding :eyes: and will follow up with manual smoke once fix is up.
